GENERAL MANAGER’S REPORT (DISCUSSION ONLY) a) Financial Matters b) Capital Report c) Property Management d) Recreation Programs e) Park, Recreation and Open Space Advisory Committee Report f) Events g) Legislation

GENERAL PUBLIC COMMENT - UP TO 15 MINUTES – THIS ITEM WILL BE CONTINUED TO ITEM 11 At this time, members of the public may address the Commission on items of interest to the public that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission and that do not appear on the agenda. With respect to agenda items, you will have opportunity to address the Commission when the item is reached in the meeting.
SAN FRANCISCO ZOO Presentation and discussion only to update the Commission on operational and management issues at the San Francisco Zoo. (DISCUSSION ONLY)

350 AMBER DRIVE – SHADOW ON GEORGE CHRISTOPHER PLAYGROUND AND GLEN CANYON PARK Discussion and possible action to adopt a resolution recommending to the Planning Commission regarding whether or not the net new shadow cast by the proposed project at 350 Amber Drive will have a significant adverse impact on the use of George Christopher Playground and Glen Canyon Park, as required by Planning Code Section 295 (the Sunlight Ordinance). (ACTION ITEM) Staff: Chris Townes –

INDIA BASIN WATERFRONT PARK – ACQUISITION Discussion and possible action to (1) recommend that the Board of Supervisors approve the use of a total of $5,000 in Open Space Acquisition Funds to purchase five water lots at India Basin (Block 4598, lots 010, 011, 012, 013, and 014) at fair market value; (2) update the Recreation and Park Department 5-Year Capital Expenditure Plan to include the sites as part of the India Basin Waterfront Park Project; and (3) recommend that the Board of Supervisors approve the associated purchase and sale agreements. (ACTION ITEM) Staff: Chris Townes –

JAPANTOWN PEACE PLAZA RENOVATION – CONTRACT AMENDMENT Discussion and possible action to amend the construction contract with Plant Construction Company L.P., for the Japantown Peace Plaza Renovation (Contract No. 0000008378) to increase the contract amount to $ 21,000,000.00, reflecting an increase of $5,546,784.00 and to extend the contract to 733 days, reflecting an increase of 233 days since last approved by Commission. (ACTION ITEM) Staff: J. Marien Coss – 10. CLOSED SESSION – CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL

GENERAL PUBLIC COMMENT – CONTINUED FROM ITEM 4 IF NECESSARY At this time members of the public who were not able to address the Commission on Item 4 may address the Commission on items that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Recreation and Park Commission that do not appear on the agenda. (ACTION ITEM)

COMMISSIONERS’ MATTERS This item is designed to allow Commissioners to raise issues they believe the Commission should address at future meetings. There will be no discussion of these items at this time.
